brief.headline: Musk plans SpaceX share for every US child
brief.detail: SpaceX boss Elon Musk said he will give one of his company shares to every U.S. child next year, without explaining how it would work.

brief.headline: OpenAI seeks faster fundraising before Anthropic IPO
brief.detail: Reuters reports, citing sources, that OpenAI seeks to accelerate fundraising ahead of an Anthropic IPO.

brief.headline: EQT to buy Cleanaway in A$9.3bn deal
brief.detail: Sweden's EQT agreed to acquire Australia's Cleanaway Waste Management in an A$9.3bn deal, and Cleanaway shares surged 20%.

brief.headline: US homebuilder sentiment falls near 14-1/2-year low
brief.detail: US homebuilder sentiment tumbled in October to near its lowest level in about 14-1/2 years, according to Reuters.

brief.headline: Silgan and AIP to acquire Trivium Packaging
brief.detail: Silgan and American Industrial Partners agreed to acquire Trivium Packaging in a $3.4 billion deal, Yahoo Finance reports.
